messages:
alex: Quick flag: ran into a compatibility snag between client shims and the routing policy fallback. Old clients that used to clear routehint are now sending no routing header and getting routed to default:low, which is tripping quota in our internal perf tests.
maria: Can you paste a minimal repro / example headers?
alex: Repro is simple: legacy SDKs remove the header. New routing code distinguishes missing header vs explicit fallback. Logs show: 
``
(no routing header) => routed to tier: default-low
expected when clearing => x-rd-route: fallback=explicit
```
kevin: Is this from the change where client.setRouting(null) normalized to header removal? I thought we kept an explicit token.
alex: The shim normalizes null -> delete header to keep wire small. Policy changed to prefer explicit hint when present, otherwise assume missing means default-low. So two choices: have SDKs send an explicit fallback header when users clear, or change policy to treat missing==explicit.
julie: Sending an explicit header seems more transparent for auditing in Console. But it does subtly change what the SDK sends over the wire (potentially surprising for few).
sam: I vote SDK emits an explicit lightweight header for a transitional period: `x-rd-route: fallback=implicit`. That preserves behaviour and lets us measure.
kevin: I can cut a TS and Go patch this week to emit that header. Python likely needs one extra day for tests.
maria: I can add a Console tile to surface counts: missing vs explicit x-rd-route, split by `sdk-client` header if present. Will help track which SDK versions are out there.
julie: We need a short migration blurb in the SDK release notes and a snippet showing how to opt into explicit routing if you rely on header removal. Also clarify that this is temporary for one minor release.
sam: Proposed rollout: 
- SDKs (py/ts/go) emit `x-rd-route: fallback=implicit` when user clears routehint; ship as patch/minor.
- Console: new telemetry tile and alert for spike of missing-header routed to low tier.
- Policy: For 4 weeks, accept `fallback=implicit` as explicit fallback; measure.
- After 4 weeks, migrate server to consider missing header == fallback and then remove the extra header in next major SDK (breaking-change notice).
alex: Timelines: TS/Go patches this week (kevin), Py +1 day (alex). Maria: can you get the tile up in staging by EOD Thu? Julie: prepare migration note for release. Sam: coordinate rollout notes and QA checklist.
maria: One question: should telemetry tag missing-header requests as `sdk-client:legacy` automatically? We could also try to parse UA if sdk-client header absent.
alex: Yes, put `sdk-client:legacy` when header absent and UA parse fallback. Add a label in the tile for "legacy-unknown".
maria: Will do. Also adding a small histogram of quota consumption for those flows so SRE can spot regressions.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z. Full rollout target: 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z pending QA.
kevin: I'll open PRs for ts/go patches and link them here.
alex: I'll drop the py PR and run the staging smoke. Will report results here.
julie: I'll draft the migration snippet and a short FAQ around why SDK now sends a tiny header and how long it'll live.
sam: I'll author the release notes and add a short blurb to the Console announcements channel.
alex: Action items summary: kevin - TS/Go patch; alex - Py patch + staging smoke; maria - console tile + telemetry labels; julie - migration snippet; sam - release notes + announcement. I'll update this thread when staging passes.
maria: One more: add a sampling flag in the tile so we can traceroute specific request ids for debugging without PII.
alex: Good call. Include traceable request id prefix `rd-debug-` for internal use only.
maria: Will add to tile config. :rocket:
